reports.title: Columbia Sportswear Company Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results;

guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Financial Outlook
section: •Net sales of $3.46 to $3.50 billion (prior $3.43 to $3.50 billion), representing net sales growth of 2.0 to 3.0 percent (prior 1.0 to 3.0 percent) compared to 2025.
•Gross margin of 52.1 percent to 52.3 percent (unchanged), including the impact of IEEPA tariff refunds.
•Operating income of $300 to $320 million (prior $290 to $325 million), representing operating margin of 8.7 to 9.1 percent of net sales (prior 8.5 to 9.3 percent).
•Diluted earnings per share of $4.65 to $4.90 (prior $4.45 to $4.90).

PORTLAND, Ore. - October 29, 2026 - Columbia Sportswear Company (NASDAQ: COLM, the “Company”), a multi-brand global leading innovator in outdoor, active and lifestyle products including apparel, footwear, accessories, and equipment, today announced third quarter 2026 financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Tim Boyle commented, “We’re pleased to have delivered net sales and EPS growth exceeding our guidance for the third quarter. These results primarily reflected a portion of delayed Fall ’26 wholesale orders shipping earlier-than-expected, improved trends in our U.S. DTC business, and the continued momentum of our international business, despite challenging global macroeconomic conditions.

“Our third quarter performance provides continued tangible signs of progress with our ACCELERATE Growth Strategy. We are particularly encouraged by the momentum building in our Columbia brand U.S. DTC E-Commerce business, which represents the pinnacle expression of our brand.

“While fourth quarter execution will be critical to our full year performance, better-than-expected third quarter performance combined with improving trends in our U.S. business and the shipment of remaining Fall ’26 global wholesale orders gives us the confidence to raise the low end of our full-year revenue and EPS guidance.

“The operating environment remains challenging and uncertain, and we will continue working to elevate the Columbia brand and improve consumer perceptions in the U.S. That said, we are increasingly confident that the Columbia brand ACCELERATE Growth Strategy is gaining traction and putting us on the right track to return to healthy, sustainable growth over the longer-term.
